section_insight: Overall health score is stable-to-slightly-declining (94 → 92, slope -1.0/period, R²=0.75). No single period crossed the 5-point inflection threshold at the overall level, but coupling collapsed 19 points (100 → 81) between the May 2 and May 13 snapshots — the dominant driver of any future risk. The drop is strongly correlated (r=0.99) and coincides with the multi-phase foundation build (Phases A–D: user_settings, per-user OAuth, data isolation, webhook mapping) that significantly expanded inter-module dependencies. Cohesion improved markedly (+7 pts, 93 → 100) over the same period, reflecting the deliberate decomposition work (db.ts split into domain modules, useCoachThread refactor, CoachWorkspace sub-components). Smells and duplication drifted downward by ~5 pts each, consistent with rapid feature accumulation outpacing cleanup. The codebase is healthy overall (grade A) but coupling is the single metric to watch.

score_annotations.label: Feature sprint peak
score_annotations.description: Baseline snapshot during high-output feature period: 7 health signals, Chat tab, nap tracker, illness early-warning. Score 94 reflects clean state before multi-user foundation work began.

score_annotations.label: Coach streaming / cache work
score_annotations.description: Score slips to 92. Smells drop 6 pts (100→94), duplication drops 8 pts (96→88), coupling drops 7 pts (100→93). Pattern matches rapid feature iteration without refactor passes. Coach streaming PR (#105) and prompt-caching work added new code paths.

score_annotations.label: Multi-user foundation (Phases A–D) — coupling inflection
score_annotations.description: Overall score holds at 92 but coupling falls a further 12 pts to 81 (19-pt total drop from baseline — above the 5-pt inflection threshold). Cohesion recovers strongly to 100 from 92. Coupling regression driven by Phases A–D: user_settings vault helpers, per-user OAuth (HMAC state), data isolation (user_id on all domain tables, forUser wrapper), webhook mapping, and encrypted integrations vault — each added cross-module wiring. Commits 01640af, c97ede3, d5a5623, 9ef72ca are primary contributors.

historical_events.notes: Score 94. Clean baseline after completing 7 health signals and Chat feature. Coupling and smells both at 100 — no technical debt visible yet.

Score 92. Duplication and smells drive the drop. Despite db.ts and useCoachThread refactors improving cohesion, new coach/streaming code paths introduced clones and smells faster than cleanup could keep up.

INFLECTION: Coupling 100→81 (-19 pts, exceeds 5-pt threshold). Multi-user foundation Phases A–D wired user_id across all domain tables, added forUser wrappers, HMAC OAuth state, webhook-to-user mapping, and encrypted vault — all legitimately increasing import/call graph density. Cohesion counterintuitively improved (93→100) because the same work forced cleaner module boundaries. Overall score masked by cohesion gain holding total at 92.
